source_title: 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards Winners: See the Complete List - People.com
source_excerpt:
‘General Hospital,’ ‘Beyond the Gates,’ ‘The Kelly Clarkson Show’ and more were among the big winners of the night on Friday, Oct. 30
Benjamin VanHoose is the Senior News Editor on the TV team at PEOPLE. He has written about entertainment and breaking news for the brand since 2019.
The 2026 Daytime Emmy Awards were held Friday, Oct. 30
General Hospital won Outstanding Daytime Drama Series, and two categories resulted in a tie, among other notable moments
Actress Genie Francis accepted the Lifetime Achievement Award during the ceremony
It was a big night for daytime television.
The 53rd annual Daytime Emmy Awards ceremony aired live from the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles on YouTube Friday, Oct. 30.
During the show, General Hospital star Genie Francis accepted the Lifetime Achievement Award , presented to her by husband, actor Jonathan Frakes, who got emotional onstage praising the star and her 50-year soap career.
General Hospital took the top prize for Outstanding Daytime Drama Series, while Beyond the Gates claimed four wins of its landmark 15 nominations for its first year of eligibility. The Kelly Clarkson Show was honored in several categories after the singer’s series came to an end earlier this year , and Tracee Ellis Ross became a first-time Emmy winner when Solo Traveling with Tracee Ellis Ross won Outstanding Travel and Adventure Program.
Two categories resulted in ties: Outstanding Hairstyling and Makeup for a Daytime Program, and Outstanding Writing for a Daytime Non-Fiction Series.
Read on for the complete list of nominees and winners.
